title: Threat-Preserving Representation Sensitivity in Agent-Security Benchmarks
title_zh: 智能体安全基准中的威胁保留表示敏感性

paragraphs.en: Security benchmarks for LLM-based agents often report the attack success rate (ASR) as a measure of model robustness and use these scores to compare different models and defense mechanisms, assuming that they describe the security of the agent. Prior work has shown that tool metadata can influence agent behavior. In this paper, we explore whether it also influences the benchmark’s measurement. We ask how much a measured ASR reflects the robustness of the agent, and how much it reflects the way the benchmark happens to represent the threat.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体的安全基准测试通常以攻击成功率（ASR）作为衡量模型鲁棒性的指标，并利用这些分数来比较不同模型和防御机制，假设这些分数能够反映智能体的安全性。 先前的研究已经表明，工具元数据可能会影响智能体的行为。 在本文中，我们探讨这种影响是否也会作用于基准测试的测量结果。 我们试图探究：测得的 ASR 在多大程度上反映了智能体的鲁棒性，又在多大程度上反映了基准测试恰好呈现威胁的方式。

sents.en: Security benchmarks for LLM-based agents often report the attack success rate (ASR) as a measure of model robustness and use these scores to compare different models and defense mechanisms, assuming that they describe the security of the agent.

sents.en: Prior work has shown that tool metadata can influence agent behavior.

sents.en: In this paper, we explore whether it also influences the benchmark’s measurement.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们探讨这种影响是否也会作用于基准测试的测量结果。

sents.en: We ask how much a measured ASR reflects the robustness of the agent, and how much it reflects the way the benchmark happens to represent the threat.
sents.zh: 我们试图探究：测得的 ASR 在多大程度上反映了智能体的鲁棒性，又在多大程度上反映了基准测试恰好呈现威胁的方式。

paragraphs.en: To measure the effect of the benchmark representation, we introduce threat-preserving representation sensitivity (TPRS), which measures how much the ASR changes when we change the agent-visible representation while holding the underlying task, harmful action, security policy, ground truth, environment, and the evaluation criteria fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量基准表示的效果，我们引入了威胁保留表示敏感性（TPRS），它用于衡量在保持底层任务、有害行为、安全策略、真实情况、环境和评估标准不变的情况下，改变智能体可见的表示时，自动识别率（ASR）会发生多大程度的变化。

paragraphs.en: We show that across 28,904 agent runs on three independent benchmarks, the attack success rate moves in both directions, showing substantial but non-uniform sensitivity. On Agent Security Bench (ASB), replacing threat-related tool names with threat-neutral names raises the committed attack success rate by 11.67 11.67 percentage points on GPT-5-mini and by 13.21 13.21 points on Claude Haiku 4.5. On MCPTox, replacing the original neutral tool name with an explicit threat-related name lowers the ASR by 11.00 11.00 percentage points on GPT-5-mini and 4.11 4.11 points on Claude Haiku 4.5. On AgentDojo, adding threat-related wording to the attack-relevant tool changes ASR by only 0.50 0.50 percentage points on GPT-4o-mini, yet the benign utility falls by 5.36 5.36 points on tasks requiring that tool.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个独立基准测试上对 28,904 次智能体运行进行的分析表明，攻击成功率会朝两个方向变化，显示出显著但非均匀的一致性。 在 Agent Security Bench（ASB）上，将威胁相关的工具名称替换为中性名称后，GPT-5-mini 上的承诺攻击成功率上升了 11.67 个百分点，而 Claude Haiku 4.5 上的上升幅度为 13.21 个百分点。 在 MCPTox 上，将原本中性的工具名称替换为明确的威胁相关名称后，GPT-5-mini 上的攻击成功率（ASR）下降了 11.00 个百分点，而 Claude Haiku 4.5 上的下降幅度为 4.11 个百分点。 在 AgentDojo 上，为与攻击相关的工具添加威胁相关的措辞后，GPT-4o-mini 上的攻击成功率（ASR）仅变化了 0.50 个百分点，但在需要该工具的任务中，其良性效用却下降了 5.36 个点。

paragraphs.en: We also show that the sensitivity is not explainable by threat vocabulary alone. We ran an experiment on MCPTox where we observed that a threat-neutral name matched on token count, length, and casing reproduces most of the shift produced by the threat-explicit name (8.54 of 11.00 points on GPT-5-mini).
paragraphs.zh: 我们还表明，这种敏感性无法仅通过威胁词汇来解释。 我们在 MCPTox 上运行了一项实验，观察到与威胁中性名称在词元数量、长度和大小写上匹配的名称，能够复现威胁明确名称所产生的大部分变化（在 GPT-5-mini 上为 11.00 分中的 8.54 分）。

sents.en: We also show that the sensitivity is not explainable by threat vocabulary alone.
sents.zh: 我们还表明，这种敏感性无法仅通过威胁词汇来解释。

sents.zh: 我们在 MCPTox 上运行了一项实验，观察到与威胁中性名称在词元数量、长度和大小写上匹配的名称，能够复现威胁明确名称所产生的大部分变化（在 GPT-5-mini 上为 11.00 分中的 8.54 分）。

paragraphs.en: The results show that a security score measured under one representation may fail to generalize across threat-preserving representations of the same security problem. Robustness claims should therefore be supported by performance across a controlled set of threat-preserving representations rather than relying on a single representation-dependent score.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果表明，在一种表示方式下测得的安全分数可能无法推广到同一安全问题的其他威胁保留型表示方式中。 因此，稳健性主张应通过在一组受控的威胁保留型表示方式中的表现来支持，而不是依赖单一表示方式相关的分数。

sents.en: The results show that a security score measured under one representation may fail to generalize across threat-preserving representations of the same security problem.
sents.zh: 研究结果表明，在一种表示方式下测得的安全分数可能无法推广到同一安全问题的其他威胁保留型表示方式中。

sents.en: Robustness claims should therefore be supported by performance across a controlled set of threat-preserving representations rather than relying on a single representation-dependent score.
sents.zh: 因此，稳健性主张应通过在一组受控的威胁保留型表示方式中的表现来支持，而不是依赖单一表示方式相关的分数。

paragraphs.en: Security benchmarks for LLM agents summarize the complex behavior of an LLM agent using metrics like attack success rate (ASR) so that it is easy to assess or compare a model’s security. Such scores can be used to make an argument for a model’s robustness against a certain class of attack or for a defense [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体的安全基准通过攻击成功率（ASR）等指标来概括LLM智能体的复杂行为，从而便于对模型的安全性进行评估或比较。 这类分数可用于论证模型在应对特定类型攻击时的鲁棒性，或用于说明某种防御措施 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。

sents.en: Security benchmarks for LLM agents summarize the complex behavior of an LLM agent using metrics like attack success rate (ASR) so that it is easy to assess or compare a model’s security.
sents.zh: LLM智能体的安全基准通过攻击成功率（ASR）等指标来概括LLM智能体的复杂行为，从而便于对模型的安全性进行评估或比较。

sents.en: Such scores can be used to make an argument for a model’s robustness against a certain class of attack or for a defense [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
sents.zh: 这类分数可用于论证模型在应对特定类型攻击时的鲁棒性，或用于说明某种防御措施 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Because LLM agents condition their actions on the context they receive, an agent-security benchmark can itself influence the behavior it measures. To measure the success of an attack, the benchmark must decide how to present the environment and the attack to the model. It has to choose the names of the tools, the descriptions of the tools, how their capabilities are described, and what instructions or data the agent receives before acting. All these choices become part of the input fed to the LLM and can influence its behavior [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . This raises an important question. If the underlying task, attack mechanism, harmful action, environment, and evaluation criteria remain the same while only this representation changes, how stable is the security score?
paragraphs.zh: 由于大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）会根据所接收的上下文来调整其行为，因此智能体安全基准本身可能会影响其所测量的行为。 为了衡量攻击的成功程度，该基准必须决定如何向模型呈现环境和攻击方式。 它需要选择工具的名称、工具的描述、对其能力的说明方式，以及智能体在执行操作前所接收的指令或数据。 所有这些选择都会成为输入到大型语言模型（LLM）的一部分，并可能影响其行为 [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] 。 这引出了一个重要的问题。 如果基础任务、攻击机制、有害行为、环境和评估标准保持不变，而仅改变这种呈现方式，那么安全得分的稳定性如何？

sents.en: Because LLM agents condition their actions on the context they receive, an agent-security benchmark can itself influence the behavior it measures.
sents.zh: 由于大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）会根据所接收的上下文来调整其行为，因此智能体安全基准本身可能会影响其所测量的行为。

sents.en: To measure the success of an attack, the benchmark must decide how to present the environment and the attack to the model.
sents.zh: 为了衡量攻击的成功程度，该基准必须决定如何向模型呈现环境和攻击方式。

sents.en: It has to choose the names of the tools, the descriptions of the tools, how their capabilities are described, and what instructions or data the agent receives before acting.
sents.zh: 它需要选择工具的名称、工具的描述、对其能力的说明方式，以及智能体在执行操作前所接收的指令或数据。

sents.en: All these choices become part of the input fed to the LLM and can influence its behavior [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
sents.zh: 所有这些选择都会成为输入到大型语言模型（LLM）的一部分，并可能影响其行为 [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] 。

sents.en: This raises an important question.
sents.zh: 这引出了一个重要的问题。

sents.en: If the underlying task, attack mechanism, harmful action, environment, and evaluation criteria remain the same while only this representation changes, how stable is the security score?
sents.zh: 如果基础任务、攻击机制、有害行为、环境和评估标准保持不变，而仅改变这种呈现方式，那么安全得分的稳定性如何？

paragraphs.en: For example, in Agent Security Bench (ASB) [ 1 ] , the benchmark uses a tool named DNSPoisoning . Suppose we change just the tool name to a more neutral-sounding DNSConfiguration while keeping everything else the same. If the ASR changes, what should the difference in ASR be attributed to? Does it reflect a difference in the agent’s security behavior, or sensitivity to how the benchmark represents the same underlying threat?
paragraphs.zh: 例如，在 Agent Security Bench (ASB) [ 1 ] 中，该基准测试使用了一个名为 DNSPoisoning 的工具。 假设我们仅将工具名称更改为听起来更中立的 DNSConfiguration，而其他一切保持不变。 如果 ASR 发生了变化，这种差异应归因于什么？ 这是否反映了智能体安全行为的差异，还是对基准测试如何表示相同潜在威胁的敏感性问题？

sents.en: For example, in Agent Security Bench (ASB) [ 1 ] , the benchmark uses a tool named DNSPoisoning .
sents.zh: 例如，在 Agent Security Bench (ASB) [ 1 ] 中，该基准测试使用了一个名为 DNSPoisoning 的工具。

sents.en: Suppose we change just the tool name to a more neutral-sounding DNSConfiguration while keeping everything else the same.
sents.zh: 假设我们仅将工具名称更改为听起来更中立的 DNSConfiguration，而其他一切保持不变。

sents.en: If the ASR changes, what should the difference in ASR be attributed to?
sents.zh: 如果 ASR 发生了变化，这种差异应归因于什么？

sents.en: Does it reflect a difference in the agent’s security behavior, or sensitivity to how the benchmark represents the same underlying threat?
sents.zh: 这是否反映了智能体安全行为的差异，还是对基准测试如何表示相同潜在威胁的敏感性问题？

paragraphs.en: This distinction matters when one uses a benchmark score to compare models or evaluate proposed defenses. If a reported result is sensitive to representational choices such as tool names or descriptions, conclusions drawn from a single benchmark configuration may be narrower than the reported score alone suggests.
paragraphs.zh: 当使用基准分数来比较模型或评估所提出的防御措施时，这种区别就显得尤为重要。 如果报告的结果对表示方式的选择（例如工具名称或描述）较为敏感，那么仅基于单一基准配置得出的结论可能比仅从报告分数中推断出的结果更为有限。

sents.en: This distinction matters when one uses a benchmark score to compare models or evaluate proposed defenses.
sents.zh: 当使用基准分数来比较模型或评估所提出的防御措施时，这种区别就显得尤为重要。

sents.en: If a reported result is sensitive to representational choices such as tool names or descriptions, conclusions drawn from a single benchmark configuration may be narrower than the reported score alone suggests.
sents.zh: 如果报告的结果对表示方式的选择（例如工具名称或描述）较为敏感，那么仅基于单一基准配置得出的结论可能比仅从报告分数中推断出的结果更为有限。

paragraphs.en: Previous work has shown that metadata of tools and instructions can influence which actions an LLM agent may take [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Recent work has also shown that models can recognize evaluation contexts and that behavior can change under controlled variations in evaluation-related cues or framing [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Deckenbach et al. [ 12 ] show that models trained on documents about how safety evaluation is performed perform better in safety benchmarking even without explicitly mentioning benchmarking. In this paper we ask a different question: when the model and the underlying security-relevant aspects of the task remain fixed, how stable is the security score produced by the benchmark?
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，工具和说明的元数据可能会影响 LLM 智能体可能采取的行动 [4, 5, 6]。 近期的研究也表明，模型能够识别评估上下文，并且在与评估相关的提示或框架受到受控变化时，其行为也可能随之改变 [7, 8, 9, 10, 11]。Deckenbach 等人 [12] 的研究表明，在关于如何进行安全评估的文档上训练的模型，即使没有明确提及基准测试，也能在安全基准测试中表现得更好。 在本文中，我们提出了一个不同的问题：当模型和任务中与安全相关的底层方面保持不变时，基准测试所产生的安全评分有多稳定？

sents.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，工具和说明的元数据可能会影响 LLM 智能体可能采取的行动 [4, 5, 6]。

sents.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个不同的问题：当模型和任务中与安全相关的底层方面保持不变时，基准测试所产生的安全评分有多稳定？

paragraphs.en: We call this threat-preserving representation sensitivity (TPRS) . We call a representation change threat-preserving when it changes what an agent sees but keeps the underlying task, environment, attacker objective, security policy, success criteria, and evaluation criteria fixed. We re-run the benchmark after performing threat-preserving changes and measure how much its ASR moves. A threat-preserving change does not need to leave the agent’s behavior completely unchanged. Some behavioral change by the model is expected. The question is whether a measured security score such as ASR is stable enough to support conclusions that do not depend strongly on the benchmark’s particular representational choices.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种威胁保留的表示称为敏感性（TPRS）。 当一种表示变化改变了智能体所看到的内容，但保留了底层任务、环境、攻击者目标、安全策略、成功标准和评估标准不变时，我们称这种变化为威胁保留的。 在执行威胁保留的变化后，我们会重新运行基准测试，并测量其 ASR 的变化程度。 威胁保留的变化并不需要将智能体的行为完全保持不变。 模型出现某些行为变化是意料之中的。 问题在于，像 ASR 这样的衡量安全性的分数是否足够稳定，从而能够支持那些不强烈依赖基准测试中特定表示选择的结论。

sents.en: We call this threat-preserving representation sensitivity (TPRS) .
sents.zh: 我们将这种威胁保留的表示称为敏感性（TPRS）。

sents.zh: 在执行威胁保留的变化后，我们会重新运行基准测试，并测量其 ASR 的变化程度。

sents.zh: 威胁保留的变化并不需要将智能体的行为完全保持不变。

paragraphs.en: In this paper we ask three questions. First, how much does ASR change under threat-preserving representation changes? Second, to what extent are these changes explained by explicit threat-related wording, such as ‘malicious’ or ‘poisoning’? Third, how does observed representation sensitivity differ across the tested benchmarks, models, and evaluation outcomes?
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了三个问题。 首先，在威胁保留的表示变化下，ASR 会发生多大程度的改变？ 其次，这些变化在多大程度上可以由明确的与威胁相关的措辞（例如“恶意”或“投毒”）来解释？ 第三，所观察到的表示敏感性在不同测试基准、模型和评估结果中有何差异？

sents.en: In this paper we ask three questions.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了三个问题。

sents.en: First, how much does ASR change under threat-preserving representation changes?
sents.zh: 首先，在威胁保留的表示变化下，ASR 会发生多大程度的改变？

sents.en: Second, to what extent are these changes explained by explicit threat-related wording, such as ‘malicious’ or ‘poisoning’?
sents.zh: 其次，这些变化在多大程度上可以由明确的与威胁相关的措辞（例如“恶意”或“投毒”）来解释？

sents.en: Third, how does observed representation sensitivity differ across the tested benchmarks, models, and evaluation outcomes?
sents.zh: 第三，所观察到的表示敏感性在不同测试基准、模型和评估结果中有何差异？

paragraphs.en: We use three independently developed agent-security benchmarks that differ in how they represent the attacks to answer the above questions. In Agent Security Bench (ASB) [ 1 ] the names of the tools often contain threat-related terms, so we replace them with more neutral names and re-run the benchmark. In MCPTox [ 2 ] most of the tool names are already neutral, so we replace them with threat-related names. AgentDojo [ 3 ] differs from the first two because its attacks induce misuse of ordinary tools rather than introducing a dedicated malicious tool. There we change the names of the benign tools. paragraphs.en: We show that across 28,904 agent runs, the measured security score, ASR, can depend substantially on the representation of the threat, but not uniformly. Thus, in terms of explicitness of their threat, results for ASB and MCPTox are directionally aligned: more threat-explicit naming is associated with lower measured ASR in both cases.

paragraphs.en: There are several benchmarks that are available to evaluate the security of tool-using LLM agents. InjecAgent [ 13 ] assesses the vulnerability of tool-integrated LLM agents. AgentDojo [ 3 ] evaluates agents that execute benign tools over untrusted data by measuring benign utility of the task and susceptibility to prompt injection. Agent Security Bench (ASB) [ 1 ] does a comprehensive evaluation of the agents with a variety of attacks and defenses across different scenarios and tools. More recent benchmarks study other attack surfaces such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) in MCPTox [ 2 ] to test robustness against tool poisoning in realistic MCP settings.

paragraphs.en: Prior work has shown that LLMs can be sensitive to how tools and their metadata (names, descriptions, etc.) are presented. Faghih et al. [ 4 ] modified the descriptions of the tools without changing their functionality, and some of the modifications increased tool usage by more than an order of magnitude. BiasBusters [ 5 ] compare functionally equivalent tools and show that tool selection is highly dependent on how well the query matches the exposed metadata (names, descriptions, etc.). Metadata, thus, can change the actions the agents perform. Pan et al. [ 6 ] establish the link between representation and safety more directly. They demonstrate that schema-formatted tool specifications can weaken refusals and increase unsafe tool execution, and they design a countermeasure that evaluates safety separately from the specification used to execute tools. De Zarzà et al. [ 17 ] test agent reasoning under meaning-preserving rewrites such as paraphrasing, reordering, expansion, and contraction. They keep the semantic meaning constant. paragraphs.en: Benchmark design can affect the conclusions supported by an evaluation. Zhu et al. [ 18 ] created the Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC), covering task validity, outcome validity, and reporting, and identified benchmark flaws that could lead to significant bias in measuring agent performance. Related work in security and trustworthy ML has reached a similar conclusion. Adversarial transferability conclusions rely on diversity of the evaluated architectures [ 19 ] . In membership inference, the construction of a dataset can confound privacy leakage [ 20 ] . Machine unlearning benchmarks might miss retained information and degrade model performance [ 21 ] . In all of these cases, the benchmarking procedure itself becomes part of the evidence supporting the security or safety claim.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试的设计可能会影响评估所支持得出的结论。Zhu 等人 [ 18 ] 创建了智能体基准测试清单（ABC），涵盖任务有效性、结果有效性和报告规范，并识别出可能导致智能体性能测量出现显著偏差的基准测试缺陷。 安全与可信机器学习领域的相關研究也得出了类似的结论。 对抗性可迁移性的结论依赖于所评估架构的多样性 [ 19 ] 。 在成员资格推断中，数据集的构建可能会干扰隐私泄露的判断 [ 20 ] 。 机器遗忘基准测试可能会遗漏保留的信息，并导致模型性能下降 [ 21 ] 。 在所有这些情况下，基准测试流程本身都成为支持安全或可靠性主张的证据之一。

paragraphs.en: Overall, these papers reinforce the idea that benchmark scores should be interpreted within the context of the evaluation design.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这些论文进一步强调了这样一个观点：基准测试分数应当在评估设计的背景下进行解读。

paragraphs.en: Our work extends this measurement question to already-published agent-security benchmarks. We ask how much an existing security score changes when the benchmark’s representation of the threat changes while the underlying security problem and evaluation criteria remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究将这一测量问题扩展到已经发布的智能体安全基准测试中。 我们探讨这样一个问题：当基准测试对威胁的表示发生变化，而底层的安全问题和评估标准保持不变时，现有的安全评分会发生多大程度的变化。

sents.en: Our work extends this measurement question to already-published agent-security benchmarks.
sents.zh: 我们的研究将这一测量问题扩展到已经发布的智能体安全基准测试中。

sents.en: We ask how much an existing security score changes when the benchmark’s representation of the threat changes while the underlying security problem and evaluation criteria remain fixed.

paragraphs.en: We consider an agent-security benchmark as a measurement tool whose job is to measure attack success for a particular model, attack or defense. We then ask whether the measurement of the attack’s success will remain stable when we change how the threat is represented by the benchmark while keeping the threat itself and the evaluation unchanged. In this section, we first define a threat-preserving transformation and specify what needs to be kept fixed for the threat to remain unchanged. We then show how we apply this definition to the three benchmarks we tested and how we froze the components that must stay unchanged to preserve the threat itself, and we explain what we measure and how we analyze the resulting differences.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体安全基准视为一种测量工具，其作用是为特定模型、攻击或防御衡量攻击的成功程度。 接着，我们探讨一个问题：在保持威胁本身和评估不变的前提下，如果改变基准对威胁的表示方式，攻击成功性的测量结果是否仍能保持稳定。 在本节中，我们首先定义一种威胁保留转换，并明确为了保持威胁不变，哪些要素需要固定不变。 然后，我们展示如何将这一定义应用于我们测试的三个基准，以及如何冻结必须保持不变以保留威胁本身的组件，并解释我们的测量内容以及分析所得差异的方法。

paragraphs.en: We also ensure that the transformation does not change how the attack success is defined or how it is scored. For each benchmark, we do not change any rule that is used to decide the success or failure of the attack. If the rule depends on the benchmark text, we verify that the relevant text is identical byte for byte across the experiments. If it depends on the environment state, we run the same scoring code unchanged. Thus, a change in ASR \operatorname{ASR} cannot come from changed evaluation criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还确保这种转换不会改变攻击成功性的定义方式或评分方式。 对于每个基准测试，我们都不会更改任何用于判断攻击成功或失败的规则。 如果该规则依赖于基准测试文本，我们会验证相关文本在不同实验中字节完全一致。 如果该规则依赖于环境状态，我们会运行未经修改的相同评分代码。 因此，ASR \operatorname{ASR} 的变化不可能源于评估标准的改变。

sents.zh: 我们还确保这种转换不会改变攻击成功性的定义方式或评分方式。

sents.en: For each benchmark, we do not change any rule that is used to decide the success or failure of the attack.
sents.zh: 对于每个基准测试，我们都不会更改任何用于判断攻击成功或失败的规则。

sents.en: If the rule depends on the benchmark text, we verify that the relevant text is identical byte for byte across the experiments.
sents.zh: 如果该规则依赖于基准测试文本，我们会验证相关文本在不同实验中字节完全一致。

sents.en: If it depends on the environment state, we run the same scoring code unchanged.
sents.zh: 如果该规则依赖于环境状态，我们会运行未经修改的相同评分代码。

sents.en: Thus, a change in ASR \operatorname{ASR} cannot come from changed evaluation criteria.
sents.zh: 因此，ASR \operatorname{ASR} 的变化不可能源于评估标准的改变。

paragraphs.zh: 转换的类型。 我们进行三种类型的转换，并分别进行分析。

paragraphs.en: Orthographic means changing spelling, case or punctuation of words without intentionally changing the meaning, for example, changing DNSPoisoning to DNS_Poisoning . This type of transformation tests whether the ASR \operatorname{ASR} score responds to even small changes in representation.
paragraphs.zh: 正字法修改指的是在不刻意改变词义的情况下，更改单词的拼写、大小写或标点符号，例如将 DNSPoisoning 改为 DNS_Poisoning。 这类转换用于测试 ASR \operatorname{ASR} 分数是否会对表示形式中的微小变化产生响应。

sents.en: Orthographic means changing spelling, case or punctuation of words without intentionally changing the meaning, for example, changing DNSPoisoning to DNS_Poisoning .
sents.zh: 正字法修改指的是在不刻意改变词义的情况下，更改单词的拼写、大小写或标点符号，例如将 DNSPoisoning 改为 DNS_Poisoning。

sents.en: This type of transformation tests whether the ASR \operatorname{ASR} score responds to even small changes in representation.
sents.zh: 这类转换用于测试 ASR \operatorname{ASR} 分数是否会对表示形式中的微小变化产生响应。

paragraphs.en: In these transformations, we change the wording without introducing any threat-related wording, for example, read_file to fetch_file . These transformations tell us if changing descriptive content alone can move the score, even when the new wording does not signal danger. Here, semantic-neutral means neutral with respect to explicit threat cues, not meaning-preserving.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些转换中，我们更改了措辞，但没有引入任何与威胁相关的词汇，例如将 read_file 改为 fetch_file。 这些转换告诉我们，即使新的措辞没有暗示危险，仅改变描述性内容是否也能影响得分。 此处，“语义中立”指的是相对于明确的威胁提示而言的中立，而非指意义保持不变。

sents.zh: 在这些转换中，我们更改了措辞，但没有引入任何与威胁相关的词汇，例如将 read_file 改为 fetch_file。

paragraphs.zh: 在这些转换中，我们改变了与威胁相关的措辞，同时保留了威胁本身。 例如，DNSPoisoning 变成了 DNSConfiguration。

sents.zh: 在这些转换中，我们改变了与威胁相关的措辞，同时保留了威胁本身。

paragraphs.en: The distinction between the semantic-neutral transformation and the cue-altering transformation helps us answer whether a benchmark is more sensitive to threat-related cues or to the descriptive content in general. A benchmark whose score moves under cue-altering transformations but not semantic-neutral ones is sensitive to threat signaling specifically; one whose score moves under both is sensitive to descriptive content more broadly.
paragraphs.zh: 语义中性转换与线索改变转换之间的区别，有助于我们判断基准测试对威胁相关线索更敏感，还是对描述性内容本身更敏感。 在线索改变转换下得分发生变化，但在语义中性转换下得分不变的基准测试，说明其特别对威胁信号敏感；而在两种转换下得分都会变化的基准测试，则说明其对描述性内容更为广泛地敏感。

paragraphs.en: For our experiments we chose three different benchmarks with different attack architectures: ASB [ 1 ] , MCPTox [ 2 ] , and AgentDojo [ 3 ] . Because the attacks are represented differently in each benchmark, the available threat-preserving transformations also differ. ASB offers the agent under test a distinctly named malicious tool, MCPTox poisons the metadata of an otherwise benign tool, and AgentDojo injects untrusted text via tool output and attempts to misuse tools that are also needed for legitimate tasks. We analyze each benchmark independently and do not compare effect sizes across benchmarks. The three benchmarks instead test whether representation sensitivity appears under different agent-security evaluation designs. Table I summarizes these differences and the representation we change in each benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 在实验中，我们选择了三种具有不同攻击架构的基准测试：ASB [ 1 ]、MCPTox [ 2 ] 和 AgentDojo [ 3 ]。 由于每个基准测试中攻击的表现形式不同，可用的威胁保留转换方式也存在差异。 ASB 为待测智能体提供了一个名称明确的恶意工具；MCPTox 会污染原本无害工具的元数据；而 AgentDojo 则通过工具输出注入不可信文本，并试图滥用那些同样用于合法任务的工具。 我们对每个基准测试进行独立分析，并不跨基准测试比较效应大小。 相反，这三个基准测试旨在检验：在不同智能体安全性评估设计下，表现敏感性是否会出现。 表 I 总结了这些差异以及我们在每个基准测试中更改的表现形式。

paragraphs.en: ASB scores an attack as successful by matching a fixed attack-goal sentence that the simulated attacker tool emits when invoked. We keep it byte-identical across every arm and verify this using SHA-256. We change only the information the agent reads before it decides what to do, including the attacker tool’s name, its description, or the framing of the injected instruction. Table II specifies the arms for ASB. ASB’s injection prompt names the tool to be used, so renaming the tool in A1 and A3 also changes that name inside the injected text. In A1b and A3, neutralization also rewrote the injected instruction for 4 of the 36 tools (e.g., removing ”discreetly” or replacing ”bypass” with ”route around”). For one tool (VehicleHijacking), the substitution produced an ungrammatical instruction. The A2 arm changes the task text by construction and is therefore not a threat-preserving arm. We use it only as a diagnostic.

The remaining four were left unchanged under A1.

Unlike ASB, MCPTox’s tools are given neutral names, so instead of removing threat cues we add them to measure the change in ASR \operatorname{ASR} in the opposite direction. Table III specifies the arms for MCPTox. S3 is a threat-neutral control matched to N1 on the measured properties of the identifier, allowing us to test whether the N1 effect is explained by explicit threat wording rather than identifier form.

paragraphs.en: AgentDojo injects untrusted text through tool output and attempts to misuse ordinary tools that are also used for legitimate tasks. Attack success is determined from the resulting environment state using the benchmark’s evaluator. Changing a tool name therefore changes what the agent sees but does not change the rule used to decide whether the attack succeeded.
paragraphs.zh: AgentDojo 通过工具输出注入不可信文本，并试图滥用那些也用于合法任务的普通工具。 攻击是否成功，是根据最终的环境状态以及基准测试的评估器来判定的。 因此，更改工具名称会改变智能体所看到的内容，但不会改变用于判断攻击是否成功的规则。

paragraphs.en: Scope: We run 40 user tasks and 14 injection tasks with 4 arms and 5 replicates on GPT-4o-mini, for a total of 11,462 runs. The evaluated suite contains 11,182 injected and 280 un-injected trajectories in which AgentDojo runs each injection task as a user task. Because AgentDojo pairs only applicable user-task/injection combinations, this is not a full cross-product. The primary security analysis uses the four injection tasks whose attack path requires the renamed tool, giving 160 base cases per arm; the remaining runs are used for benign utility and diagnostics. We evaluate AgentDojo with GPT-4o-mini as it was the current API-available model supported by the benchmark’s native model interface. We kept the benchmark harness unchanged rather than introduce a separate model integration, and therefore treat AgentDojo as a benchmark-specific evaluation rather than a cross-model comparison.

paragraphs.en: We measure threat wording using the same threat lexicon across all three benchmarks. paragraphs.en: ASB and MCPTox are evaluated on GPT-5-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5. GPT-5-mini is run with reasoning effort set to low, since it does not allow the temperature to be set, and a 4096-token completion budget. On MCPTox, Haiku 4.5 is run at temperature 0 with a 1024-token budget; on ASB, the benchmark’s Anthropic client does not pass a temperature, so Haiku 4.5 runs at the API default temperature with a 4096-token budget. AgentDojo is evaluated on GPT-4o-mini using the benchmark’s native harness, with temperature 0 and the harness’s default token budget. We use GPT-4o-mini since it was the most recent OpenAI model natively supported by AgentDojo, avoiding a separate model integration.
paragraphs.zh: ASB 和 MCPTox 在 GPT-5-mini 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 上进行评估。 GPT-5-mini 的运行中，推理努力程度设为低，因为它不允许设置温度，且使用 4096 个标记的完成预算。 在 MCPTox 上，Haiku 4.5 以温度 0 和 1024 个标记的预算运行；在 ASB 上，该基准测试的 Anthropic 客户端未传递温度参数，因此 Haiku 4.5 以 API 默认温度和 4096 个标记的预算运行。 AgentDojo 使用 GPT-4o-mini 在该基准测试的原生工具包上进行评估，设置温度为 0，并使用工具包的默认标记预算。 我们使用 GPT-4o-mini，因为它是 AgentDojo 原生支持的最新 OpenAI 模型，从而避免了单独集成其他模型。

paragraphs.en: For our experiments, we keep the benchmark system and task prompts unchanged. We use repeated runs and report replicate variability rather than assuming deterministic model outputs. We record provider errors, and runs in which the model produces no usable plan, as execution failures rather than attack outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们保持基准系统和任务提示不变。 我们通过重复运行并报告复制变异性来代替假设模型输出是确定性的。 我们将提供商的错误以及模型未生成可用计划的运行记录为执行失败，而非攻击结果。

sents.en: For our experiments, we keep the benchmark system and task prompts unchanged.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们保持基准系统和任务提示不变。

sents.en: We use repeated runs and report replicate variability rather than assuming deterministic model outputs.
sents.zh: 我们通过重复运行并报告复制变异性来代替假设模型输出是确定性的。

sents.en: We record provider errors, and runs in which the model produces no usable plan, as execution failures rather than attack outcomes.
sents.zh: 我们将提供商的错误以及模型未生成可用计划的运行记录为执行失败，而非攻击结果。

paragraphs.en: ASB considers an attack successful when a harmful tool is invoked, even if the agent also refuses; 5–28% of its scored successes include a refusal. Thus, alongside the native ASR, we also report a committed ASR, which considers an attack successful only when the agent does not refuse at any point. We detect refusals with a fixed keyword pattern; using ASB’s own LLM refusal judge instead changes the A1 and A3 effects by at most 1.2 points. The native ASR is useful when the invocation of the tool itself is the security failure, while committed ASR captures if the agent continues to engage in harmful behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 当有害工具被调用时，ASB 就认为攻击成功，即使智能体也拒绝了；其评分成功的案例中，有 5%–28% 包含了拒绝行为。 因此，除了原生 ASR 之外，我们还报告了“承诺型 ASR”，它仅在智能体全程未拒绝的情况下才认为攻击成功。 我们通过固定的关键词模式来检测拒绝行为；若改用 ASB 自身的 LLM 拒绝判定器，则对 A1 和 A3 的影响最多仅为 1.2 分。 当工具调用本身即构成安全漏洞时，原生 ASR 很有用；而“承诺型 ASR”则能判断智能体是否持续进行有害行为。

paragraphs.en: MCPTox does not provide a scorer but comes with precomputed labels. Thus we reimplemented its scoring taxonomy and validated it against published labels. Of its 1,348 cases, 203 contain the two signals required by our executable scorer: the target tool identified in the poisoned description and a payload marker distinct from the benign user request. This subset was fixed before any model outcomes were examined. The subset is not uniformly representative of all possible MCPTox categories. On the 203 cases we evaluated, our implementation had 95.3% recall and a 0.7% false-positive rate.
paragraphs.zh: MCPTox 并未提供评分器，但附带了预计算好的标签。 因此，我们重新实现了其评分分类体系，并通过与已发表的标签进行比对进行了验证。 在其 1,348 个案例中，有 203 个包含了我们的可执行评分器所需的两个信号：中毒描述中识别出的目标工具，以及一个与良性用户请求不同的有效载荷标记。 在检查任何模型结果之前，这一子集就已经确定好了。 该子集并不能均匀地代表所有可能的 MCPTox 类别。 在我们评估的 203 个案例中，我们的实现实现了 95.3% 的召回率和 0.7% 的假阳性率。

paragraphs.en: For AgentDojo, we use the benchmark’s existing security and benign utility scorers without modification.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 AgentDojo，我们直接使用基准测试中现有的安全性和良性效用评分器，无需任何修改。

paragraphs.en: We apply transformations per tool in ASB, per case in MCPTox, and per base case in AgentDojo. Runs that share the same transformed identifier are therefore not independent. We account for this by clustering at the level where the transformation is applied.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ASB 中，我们按工具应用变换；在 MCPTox 中，按案例应用变换；在 AgentDojo 中，按基础案例应用变换。 因此，共享相同变换后标识符的运行并非相互独立。 我们通过在其变换被应用的层级上进行聚类来处理这一问题。

sents.zh: 在 ASB 中，我们按工具应用变换；在 MCPTox 中，按案例应用变换；在 AgentDojo 中，按基础案例应用变换。

sents.en: Runs that share the same transformed identifier are therefore not independent.

sents.zh: 我们通过在其变换被应用的层级上进行聚类来处理这一问题。

paragraphs.en: We compare the same units across arms whenever possible. In MCPTox, cases are paired across arms, and in AgentDojo the same base cases are paired across arms. ASB requires an additional step because its result files do not contain task identifiers and rows are written in completion order. We therefore combine the five task outcomes within each (tool, replicate) group and pair these groups across arms. Some groups are smaller because of execution failures, runs in which the model produced no usable plan. These occurred only on Haiku 4.5 (229 of 3,240 runs).
paragraphs.zh: 只要可能，我们都会在不同分支间比较相同的单元。 在 MCPTox 中，各分支的实例会被配对；而在 AgentDojo 中，则是将相同的基准实例在不同分支间进行配对。 ASB 需要额外的一步操作，因为其结果文件中不包含任务标识符，且各行数据是按完成顺序写入的。 因此，我们将每个（工具、重复实验）组内的五个任务结果合并，并将这些组在不同分支间进行配对。 由于执行失败——即模型未能生成任何可用计划的运行——某些组的规模会较小。 这种情况仅出现在 Haiku 4.5 上（3,240 次运行中有 229 次）。

paragraphs.en: We report paired differences in ASR with 95% confidence intervals from 10,000 cluster-bootstrap samples. All reported estimates are produced by the same reproducible analysis pipeline with fixed random seeds.

paragraphs.en: Execution failure rates differ across some ASB arms on Haiku 4.5; for example, A0 has a 4.1% failure rate and A1 has 5.9%. Simply dropping these failures could bias the comparison. paragraphs.en: We made two additional design choices after the initial study. The S3 arm was not part of the original MCPTox design. S3 was added after the initial MCPTox results prompted us to examine whether N1 differed from S1/S2 in identifier form as well as threat wording. The S3 transformation, the N1–S3 contrast, and the analysis rule were fixed before any S3 model outcomes were observed. We therefore treat S3 as an adaptively motivated follow-up control rather than as part of the original experimental design.
paragraphs.zh: 在初步研究之后，我们又做出了两项额外的设计选择。 S3 分支并非原始 MCPTox 设计的一部分。 在初步的 MCPTox 结果促使我们考察 N1 是否在标识符形式和威胁措辞方面都与 S1/S2 存在差异后，我们才加入了 S3。 在观察到任何 S3 模型结果之前，S3 的转换方式、N1–S3 对比以及分析规则均已确定。 因此，我们将 S3 视为一种基于适应性动机而引入的后续对照，而非原始实验设计的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 summarizes the representation sensitivity effects across all three benchmarks. The direction and magnitude of the effect vary by benchmark and transformation type: ASB’s cue-altering renames increase the measured ASR when threat-related wording is removed, MCPTox shows a decrease in ASR when threat-related wording is introduced, and AgentDojo’s ASR effects remain near zero.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 总结了所有三个基准测试中表现敏感性的影响。 该影响的的方向和大小因基准测试和转换类型而异：ASB 的线索改变类重命名在移除威胁相关措辞时会提高测得的 ASR，MCPTox 在引入威胁相关措辞时则显示 ASR 下降，而 AgentDojo 的 ASR 影响则接近于零。

sents.en: Figure 2 summarizes the representation sensitivity effects across all three benchmarks.
sents.zh: 图 2 总结了所有三个基准测试中表现敏感性的影响。

sents.en: The direction and magnitude of the effect vary by benchmark and transformation type: ASB’s cue-altering renames increase the measured ASR when threat-related wording is removed, MCPTox shows a decrease in ASR when threat-related wording is introduced, and AgentDojo’s ASR effects remain near zero.

paragraphs.en: For ASB, we first evaluate whether its attack success rate changes when we remove threat-related wording from its attacker tools. Table V reports the result of each representation change relative to the original arm A0.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 ASB，我们首先评估在从其攻击者工具中移除与威胁相关的措辞后，其攻击成功率是否发生变化。 表 V 报告了每种表示方式变化相对于原始臂 A0 的结果。

sents.en: For ASB, we first evaluate whether its attack success rate changes when we remove threat-related wording from its attacker tools.
sents.zh: 对于 ASB，我们首先评估在从其攻击者工具中移除与威胁相关的措辞后，其攻击成功率是否发生变化。

sents.en: Table V reports the result of each representation change relative to the original arm A0.
sents.zh: 表 V 报告了每种表示方式变化相对于原始臂 A0 的结果。

paragraphs.en: Changing only the name of the attacker tool (A1 arm) increases the committed ASR by 11.67 percentage points (from 36.67% to 48.34%) on GPT-5-mini (95% CI [ 4.44 , 19.07 ] [4.44,19.07] ) and by 13.21 points (from 20.85% to 34.06%) on Haiku 4.5 ( [ 6.33 , 21.10 ] [6.33,21.10] ). When we make both names and descriptions (A3) neutral, we get similar increases of 13.15 points on GPT-5-mini and 14.85 points on Haiku 4.5.
paragraphs.zh: 仅更改攻击工具的名称（A1 arm），在 GPT-5-mini 上使承诺的 ASR 增加了 11.67 个百分点（从 36.67% 增至 48.34%）（95% CI [ 4.44 , 19.07 ] [4.44,19.07]），在 Haiku 4.5 上则增加了 13.21 个百分点（从 20.85% 增至 34.06%）（[ 6.33 , 21.10 ] [6.33,21.10]）。 当我们使名称和描述（A3）都保持中立时，在 GPT-5-mini 上获得了约 13.15 个百分点的增长，在 Haiku 4.5 上则增长了约 14.85 个百分点。

sents.en: Changing only the name of the attacker tool (A1 arm) increases the committed ASR by 11.67 percentage points (from 36.67% to 48.34%) on GPT-5-mini (95% CI [ 4.44 , 19.07 ] [4.44,19.07] ) and by 13.21 points (from 20.85% to 34.06%) on Haiku 4.5 ( [ 6.33 , 21.10 ] [6.33,21.10] ).
When we make both names and descriptions (A3) neutral, we get similar increases of 13.15 points on GPT-5-mini and 14.85 points on Haiku 4.5.
sents.zh: 当我们使名称和描述（A3）都保持中立时，在 GPT-5-mini 上获得了约 13.15 个百分点的增长，在 Haiku 4.5 上则增长了约 14.85 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Neither the orthographic control (NULL2), which only makes a small formatting change to the tool name, nor the description-only change (A1b) had a resolved committed ASR effect on either model. The main ASB effect therefore appears when the tool name itself is neutralized.
paragraphs.zh: 无论是仅对工具名称进行微小格式调整的拼写控制（NULL2），还是仅修改描述（A1b），这两种方式均未对任一模型产生明确且稳定的 ASR 效应。 因此，主要的 ASB 效应似乎出现在工具名称本身被中立化的情况下。

sents.zh: 因此，主要的 ASB 效应似乎出现在工具名称本身被中立化的情况下。

paragraphs.en: ASB’s native metric considers an attack successful as soon as a malicious tool is invoked; committed ASR, on the other hand, requires not only the invocation but also that the agent does not refuse at any point. The main result of the A1 arm holds up for both definitions. We see that the native ASR increases by 14.07 points (from 47.59% to 61.66%) on GPT-5-mini ( [ 5.56 , 23.70 ] [5.56,23.70] ) and 13.05 points (from 22.97% to 36.02%) on Haiku 4.5 ( [ 6.26 , 21.03 ] [6.26,21.03] ). The orthographic control remains unresolved under both metrics. Interestingly, the two metrics differ for the A1b arm: on Haiku 4.5, A1b changes native ASR by 3.28 points ( [ 0.14 , 8.59 ] [0.14,8.59] ), while its committed ASR effect is − 1.16 -1.16 points ( [ − 4.60 , 1.94 ] [-4.60,1.94] ). On GPT-5-mini, the corresponding native effect is 3.15 points ( [ − 0.19 , 7.22 ] [-0.19,7.22] ), while committed ASR does not change. We found that changing descriptions may increase the native ASR. Thus, A1b illustrates that native and committed ASR can yield different effect estimates.
paragraphs.zh: ASB 的原生指标认为，只要恶意工具被调用，攻击就算成功；而“已执行”的 ASR 则不仅要求工具被调用，还要求智能体在任何阶段都不拒绝执行。 A1 分支的主要结果在这两种定义下均成立。 我们观察到，在 GPT-5-mini（[5.56, 23.70]）上，原生 ASR 上升了 14.07 个百分点（从 47.59% 升至 61.66%）；而在 Haiku 4.5（[6.26, 21.03]）上，则上升了 13.05 个百分点（从 22.97% 升至 36.02%）。 在两种指标下，正字法控制问题仍未解决。 有趣的是，这两种指标在 A1b 分支上的结果存在差异：在 Haiku 4.5 上，A1b 使原生 ASR 变化了 3.28 个百分点（[0.14, 8.59]），而其对“已执行”ASR 的影响则为 −1.16 个百分点（[−4.60, 1.94]）。 在 GPT-5-mini 上，对应的原生影响为 3.15 个百分点（[−0.19, 7.22]），而“已执行”ASR 则未发生变化。 我们发现，修改描述可能会提高原生 ASR。 因此，A1b 表明原生 ASR 和“已执行”ASR 可能得出不同的效果估计值。

sents.en: The main result of the A1 arm holds up for both definitions.
sents.zh: A1 分支的主要结果在这两种定义下均成立。

sents.en: We see that the native ASR increases by 14.07 points (from 47.59% to 61.66%) on GPT-5-mini ( [ 5.56 , 23.70 ] [5.56,23.70] ) and 13.05 points (from 22.97% to 36.02%) on Haiku 4.5 ( [ 6.26 , 21.03 ] [6.26,21.03] ).
The orthographic control remains unresolved under both metrics.

paragraphs.en: Table VI shows that Haiku 4.5’s execution failure rate differs across arms (4.1% in A0 and 5.9% in A1), whereas GPT-5-mini shows no execution failures. Across the three failure treatments, the Haiku 4.5 estimate ranges from 12.04 to 13.89 points, and every confidence interval remains above zero.
paragraphs.zh: 表 VI 显示，Haiku 4.5 的执行失败率在不同分支中存在差异（A0 中为 4.1%，A1 中为 5.9%），而 GPT-5-mini 则未出现任何执行失败。 在三种失败处理方案中，Haiku 4.5 的估计值介于 12.04 至 13.89 分之间，且所有置信区间均高于零。

sents.en: Table VI shows that Haiku 4.5’s execution failure rate differs across arms (4.1% in A0 and 5.9% in A1), whereas GPT-5-mini shows no execution failures.
sents.zh: 表 VI 显示，Haiku 4.5 的执行失败率在不同分支中存在差异（A0 中为 4.1%，A1 中为 5.9%），而 GPT-5-mini 则未出现任何执行失败。

sents.en: Across the three failure treatments, the Haiku 4.5 estimate ranges from 12.04 to 13.89 points, and every confidence interval remains above zero.
sents.zh: 在三种失败处理方案中，Haiku 4.5 的估计值介于 12.04 至 13.89 分之间，且所有置信区间均高于零。

paragraphs.en: In our experiments we saw that no single attacker tool was driving the results. When we leave out each of the 36 tools one at a time, the A1 effect stays between 9.90 and 12.95 points on GPT-5-mini and between 11.19 and 14.40 points on Haiku 4.5. The cross-model comparison shows not much of a difference between GPT-5-mini and Haiku 4.5 on ASB. The estimated cross-model difference in the A1 effect is − 1.54 -1.54 percentage points (95% CI [ − 12.45 , + 8.44 ] [-12.45,+8.44] ), and for A3 it is − 1.70 -1.70 points ( [ − 12.00 , + 8.68 ] [-12.00,+8.68] ).
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们发现没有任何单一的攻击者工具能够主导实验结果。 当我们逐一排除这36个工具中的每一个时，A1效应在GPT-5-mini上的变化范围保持在9.90至12.95分之间，在Haiku 4.5上则保持在11.19至14.40分之间。 跨模型比较显示，在ASB任务中，GPT-5-mini与Haiku 4.5之间的差异并不显著。 A1效应的跨模型估计差异为−1.54（百分点数）（95%置信区间[−12.45, +8.44]），而A3的估计差异则为−1.70分（[−12.00, +8.68]）。

sents.en: In our experiments we saw that no single attacker tool was driving the results.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们发现没有任何单一的攻击者工具能够主导实验结果。

sents.en: When we leave out each of the 36 tools one at a time, the A1 effect stays between 9.90 and 12.95 points on GPT-5-mini and between 11.19 and 14.40 points on Haiku 4.5.
sents.zh: 当我们逐一排除这36个工具中的每一个时，A1效应在GPT-5-mini上的变化范围保持在9.90至12.95分之间，在Haiku 4.5上则保持在11.19至14.40分之间。

sents.en: The cross-model comparison shows not much of a difference between GPT-5-mini and Haiku 4.5 on ASB.
sents.zh: 跨模型比较显示，在ASB任务中，GPT-5-mini与Haiku 4.5之间的差异并不显著。

sents.en: The estimated cross-model difference in the A1 effect is − 1.54 -1.54 percentage points (95% CI [ − 12.45 , + 8.44 ] [-12.45,+8.44] ), and for A3 it is − 1.70 -1.70 points ( [ − 12.00 , + 8.68 ] [-12.00,+8.68] ).

paragraphs.en: GPT-5-mini recorded no execution failures, so all three treatments use identical data and produce identical estimates and intervals.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5-mini 未记录任何执行失败，因此三种处理方法均使用相同的数据，并生成相同的估计值和置信区间。

paragraphs.en: From the results in Table V , we have established that changing how a threat is represented changes ASB’s measured attack success rate. But we do not know exactly which part of the representation causes that change. The A1 names are less threat-related than A0, but they also differ in their token use. We noticed that on average, A1 uses fewer o200k_base tokens than the original A0 names (average of 2.83 versus 3.47). The difference is even smaller with Haiku 4.5’s tokenizer (average of 5.39 vs 5.86). Because both wording and form changed, we cannot say that threat-related wording alone caused the ASB effect.
paragraphs.zh: 根据表 V 中的结果，我们已经确定，改变威胁的表示方式会改变 ASB 的实测攻击成功率。 但我们并不确切知道表示方式的哪个部分导致了这种变化。 A1 名称与威胁的相关性低于 A0，但它们在词元使用上也存在差异。 我们注意到，平均而言，A1 使用的 o200k_base 词元比原始的 A0 名称更少（平均为 2.83 对比 3.47）。 在使用 Haiku 4.5 的tokenizer时，这种差异甚至更小（平均为 5.39 对比 5.86）。 由于措辞和形式都发生了变化，我们无法断定仅由与威胁相关的措辞导致了 ASB 效应。

sents.en: From the results in Table V , we have established that changing how a threat is represented changes ASB’s measured attack success rate.
sents.zh: 根据表 V 中的结果，我们已经确定，改变威胁的表示方式会改变 ASB 的实测攻击成功率。

sents.en: But we do not know exactly which part of the representation causes that change.
sents.zh: 但我们并不确切知道表示方式的哪个部分导致了这种变化。

sents.en: The A1 names are less threat-related than A0, but they also differ in their token use.
sents.zh: A1 名称与威胁的相关性低于 A0，但它们在词元使用上也存在差异。

sents.en: We noticed that on average, A1 uses fewer o200k_base tokens than the original A0 names (average of 2.83 versus 3.47).
sents.zh: 我们注意到，平均而言，A1 使用的 o200k_base 词元比原始的 A0 名称更少（平均为 2.83 对比 3.47）。

paragraphs.en: When we replaced the original neutral names with explicit threat-related names (arm N1), we saw a drop of about 11 percentage points (from 32.02% to 21.02%) in the attack success rate in GPT-5-mini. When we compare that to the more conservative change in threat wording of C1, it comes down by 2.96 points.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们用明确的威胁相关名称（arm N1）替换原始的中性名称时，GPT-5-mini 中的攻击成功率下降了约 11 个百分点（从 32.02% 降至 21.02%）。 与 C1 中更为保守的威胁措辞变化相比，这一降幅为 2.96 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The change of neutral names from N0 to threat-explicit wording in N1 not only changes the name and meaning but also the form. Compared to N0, N1 names are longer, contain more components, and use different casing. After observing initial N1 results, we added S3, a threat-neutral arm designed to match N1 on these measured properties without using threat-related words. Interestingly, we found that S3 alone lowers GPT-5-mini attack success rate by 8.54 percentage points. N1 compared to S3 only lowers the attack success rate by 2.46 points. By contrast, N1 compared to the broader semantic-neutral controls S1/S2 lowers the attack success rate by 8.37 points.
paragraphs.zh: 在中性名称从 N0 变为 N1 中明确提及威胁的措辞时，不仅名称和含义发生了变化，形式也发生了改变。 与 N0 相比，N1 的名称更长、包含更多组成部分，并且使用了不同的大小写格式。 在观察到初步的 N1 结果后，我们加入了 S3——一个威胁中性分支，旨在不使用与威胁相关的词汇的情况下，在这些可测量的属性上与 N1 保持一致。 有趣的是，我们发现仅使用 S3 就能将 GPT-5-mini 的攻击成功率降低 8.54 个百分点。 与 S3 相比，N1 仅将攻击成功率降低了 2.46 个百分点。 相比之下，与更广泛的语义中性对照组 S1/S2 相比，N1 将攻击成功率降低了 8.37 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: We saw in ASB that removing threat-related names increases the ASR and in MCPTox adding threat-related wording lowers the attack success rate. Based on the results we can say that representation sensitivity therefore does not have a fixed direction nor is it completely model agnostic. MCPTox’s results show clear representation sensitivity, but the exact feature responsible for that sensitivity remains only partly identified.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ASB 中看到，移除与威胁相关的名称会提高 ASR；而在 MCPTox 中，添加与威胁相关的措辞则会降低攻击成功率。 根据这些结果，我们可以得出结论：因此，表示敏感性既没有固定的方向，也并非完全与模型无关。 MCPTox 的结果显示出明显的表示敏感性，但导致这种敏感性的具体特征目前仅被部分识别出来。

paragraphs.en: AgentDojo differs from MCPTox and ASB in terms of how the attack reaches the agent. Unlike the other two benchmarks, AgentDojo does not have any malicious tool; instead, malicious instructions are injected into untrusted tool output to misuse the benign tools that are also needed for benign tasks. Thus, we add threat wording to a benign tool. For our experiment we only used the injection tasks whose attack path requires the renamed tool.
paragraphs.zh: AgentDojo 与 MCPTox 和 ASB 的不同之处在于攻击到达智能体的方式。 与其他两个基准测试不同，AgentDojo 没有任何恶意工具；相反，恶意指令会被注入到不可信的工具输出中，从而滥用那些完成良性任务所必需的良性工具。 因此，我们在一个良性工具中添加了威胁相关的措辞。 在我们的实验中，我们只使用了那些攻击路径需要重命名后工具的注入任务。

paragraphs.en: Across the three benchmarks on different models we saw that the representation sensitivity can be large but is not uniform. In ASB we saw removing threat wording makes the attack success rate jump; in MCPTox we saw that adding threat wording lowered the attack success rate, whereas in AgentDojo we saw smaller effect on attack success rate. However, we do not interpret these differences as causal effects of benchmark architecture, since the benchmarks also differ in their attacks, models, and transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 在针对不同模型的三项基准测试中，我们发现表示的敏感度可能较大，但并不均匀。 在 ASB 中，我们观察到移除威胁性措辞会使攻击成功率飙升；在 MCPTox 中，添加威胁性措辞则降低了攻击成功率，而在 AgentDojo 中，这种对攻击成功率的影响则较小。 然而，我们并不将这些差异解释为基准测试架构的因果效应，因为这些基准测试在攻击方式、模型和转换方法上也存在差异。

sents.en: Across the three benchmarks on different models we saw that the representation sensitivity can be large but is not uniform.
sents.zh: 在针对不同模型的三项基准测试中，我们发现表示的敏感度可能较大，但并不均匀。

sents.en: In ASB we saw removing threat wording makes the attack success rate jump; in MCPTox we saw that adding threat wording lowered the attack success rate, whereas in AgentDojo we saw smaller effect on attack success rate.

paragraphs.en: Our MCPTox results also show that explicit threat words are not necessary for most of the GPT-5-mini effect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 MCPTox 结果还表明，对于大多数 GPT-5-mini 效应而言，显式的威胁词汇并非必要。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we show that the representation sensitivity can depend on what the benchmark chooses to measure. In ASB, we saw the difference in committed ASR and native ASR; in AgentDojo, we saw only a small change in ASR and a larger change in the benign utility.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们证明了表示的敏感性可能取决于基准测试选择测量的内容。 在 ASB 中，我们看到了承诺 ASR 与原生 ASR 之间的差异；而在 AgentDojo 中，我们只观察到 ASR 的微小变化，以及良性效用的更大变化。

sents.en: Finally, we show that the representation sensitivity can depend on what the benchmark chooses to measure.
sents.zh: 最后，我们证明了表示的敏感性可能取决于基准测试选择测量的内容。

sents.en: In ASB, we saw the difference in committed ASR and native ASR; in AgentDojo, we saw only a small change in ASR and a larger change in the benign utility.
sents.zh: 在 ASB 中，我们看到了承诺 ASR 与原生 ASR 之间的差异；而在 AgentDojo 中，我们只观察到 ASR 的微小变化，以及良性效用的更大变化。

paragraphs.en: Thus overall we can say that an agent’s security score can depend not only on the underlying threat and model, but also on how that threat is represented and on how success is defined.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，总体而言，我们可以说，一个智能体的安全分数不仅取决于底层的威胁和模型，还取决于该威胁的表现方式以及成功如何被定义。

paragraphs.en: TPRS tests if a benchmark’s security score like ASR remains stable when the underlying security problem is held fixed but its agent-visible representation changes. We found that in ASB and MCPTox it was not stable and was comparatively stable on AgentDojo. Thus, security scores like ASR can be affected by the design decisions regarding representation.
paragraphs.zh: TPRS 测试当底层安全问题保持不变但其智能体可见的表示发生变化时，基准测试中的安全分数（如 ASR）是否保持稳定。 我们发现，在 ASB 和 MCPTox 中该分数并不稳定，而在 AgentDojo 上则相对稳定。 因此，像 ASR 这样的安全分数可能会受到与表示相关的设计决策的影响。

sents.en: TPRS tests if a benchmark’s security score like ASR remains stable when the underlying security problem is held fixed but its agent-visible representation changes.
sents.zh: TPRS 测试当底层安全问题保持不变但其智能体可见的表示发生变化时，基准测试中的安全分数（如 ASR）是否保持稳定。

sents.en: We found that in ASB and MCPTox it was not stable and was comparatively stable on AgentDojo.
sents.zh: 我们发现，在 ASB 和 MCPTox 中该分数并不稳定，而在 AgentDojo 上则相对稳定。

sents.en: Thus, security scores like ASR can be affected by the design decisions regarding representation.
sents.zh: 因此，像 ASR 这样的安全分数可能会受到与表示相关的设计决策的影响。

paragraphs.en: The security conclusions obtained from one representation are not necessarily the same under another threat-preserving representation of the same security problem. With TPRS we propose a way to test such dependence before treating a benchmark’s security score as evidence of the model’s or attack’s robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 从一种表示方法中得出的安全结论，在另一种保留威胁的相同安全问题的表示方法下，未必会保持一致。 借助 TPRS，我们提出了一种在将基准测试的安全分数视为模型或攻击鲁棒性的证据之前，检验这种依赖关系的方法。

sents.en: The security conclusions obtained from one representation are not necessarily the same under another threat-preserving representation of the same security problem.
sents.zh: 从一种表示方法中得出的安全结论，在另一种保留威胁的相同安全问题的表示方法下，未必会保持一致。

sents.en: With TPRS we propose a way to test such dependence before treating a benchmark’s security score as evidence of the model’s or attack’s robustness.
sents.zh: 借助 TPRS，我们提出了一种在将基准测试的安全分数视为模型或攻击鲁棒性的证据之前，检验这种依赖关系的方法。

paragraphs.en: Our work shows that a benchmark should treat its representation choices as part of the evaluation design. If a benchmark is used to make a generalized security claim, we recommend that it evaluate with at least one threat-preserving transformation and report any sensitivity as part of the security metric. Similarly if a particular representation also affects the benign behavior, utility should also be measured with various threat-preserving transformations. Our AgentDojo results show why a security-only comparison can miss capturing the utility effect of representation. Benchmarks should also state explicitly when the attack is considered a success. Our ASB results show that native and committed ASR capture different successes and do not exhibit identical sensitivity. In general, reporting both the benchmark configuration and its sensitivity to controlled representation changes makes clear which conclusions are properties of the underlying security problem and which may depend on how that problem is presented to the agent.

paragraphs.en: TPRS measures how much the measurement score like ASR changes under controlled representation changes, but its security interpretation can depend on who chooses that representation. When an attacker can choose the representation by picking the name of the tool or influencing the metadata associated with it (like in ASB or MCPTox), the representation can become part of the attack itself. In ASB, for example, the attacker supplies the malicious tool and chooses its name. A name such as DNSConfiguration may make the tool look benign, so A1 does not separate threat wording from apparent function (Section VI), but a neutral name costs the attacker nothing. Under this reading, ASB’s original names understate the ASR an attacker can achieve by 11.67–13.21 points (committed ASR). In such cases one should report TPRS as well as the maximum ASR observed when testing with different representations. When a benchmark designer chooses the representation, TPRS characterizes how much the measurement score like ASR is dependent on benchmark design choices. The small change in ASR with AgentDojo shows that the security measurement was comparatively stable under the tested representation changes.

paragraphs.en: Even though AgentDojo’s change in ASR was not significant, it provides a useful contrast to ASB and MCPTox. Its result shows that the large shift in sensitivity is not inevitable. Some benchmark measurements may appear much more sensitive to the representation than others. While we did not establish why AgentDojo’s change was so small compared to the other two benchmarks, it does differ from ASB and MCPTox in several ways, including how the attack reaches the agent and how the harmful action is carried out. One possibility could be that the representation matters more when the benchmark explicitly states the adversarial capability. We leave that testing to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 AgentDojo 的 ASR 变化并不显著，但它为与 ASB 和 MCPTox 的对比提供了有用的参照。 其结果表明，敏感性的巨大变化并非不可避免。 某些基准测试的测量结果可能比其他测试对表示方式更为敏感。 虽然我们尚未确定为何 AgentDojo 的变化相较于另外两个基准测试如此微小，但它在多个方面确实与 ASB 和 MCPTox 存在差异，包括攻击如何作用于智能体以及有害行为如何被执行。 一种可能性是，当基准测试明确说明对抗性能力时，表示方式的影响会更为显著。 我们将这一测试留待未来的研究。

sents.zh: 尽管 AgentDojo 的 ASR 变化并不显著，但它为与 ASB 和 MCPTox 的对比提供了有用的参照。

sents.en: Its result shows that the large shift in sensitivity is not inevitable.
sents.zh: 其结果表明，敏感性的巨大变化并非不可避免。

sents.zh: 某些基准测试的测量结果可能比其他测试对表示方式更为敏感。

sents.zh: 一种可能性是，当基准测试明确说明对抗性能力时，表示方式的影响会更为显著。

sents.zh: 我们将这一测试留待未来的研究。

paragraphs.en: We applied transformations on tool names and descriptions as they are among the most visible representations. But they are only one subset of all possible representations. There can be other types of transformation like argument names, tool schemas, instruction framings and so on. Thus we do not interpret our results as an interval of uncertainty over all the ways the same threat could be expressed. Our future work may include testing and changing other aspects of threat representations while keeping the same security criteria. One can also try to develop transformations that better preserve the tool’s described function while varying threat-related representation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对工具名称和描述进行了转换，因为它们是其中最显眼的表现形式之一。 但它们只是所有可能表现形式中的一个子集。 还可以有其他类型的转换，例如参数名称、工具模式、指令框架等等。 因此，我们并不将研究结果解释为同一威胁所有可能表达方式之间的不确定性区间。 我们的未来工作可能包括在保持相同安全标准的同时，测试并改变威胁表现形式的其他方面。 也可以尝试开发能够更好保留工具所描述功能、同时改变与威胁相关的表现形式的转换方法。

sents.zh: 也可以尝试开发能够更好保留工具所描述功能、同时改变与威胁相关的表现形式的转换方法。

paragraphs.en: There is also a tradeoff between making the names more noticeably threat-related and maintaining the meaning of the representation. In our ASB experiment’s A1 arm, the changes in the names were not independently validated for semantic equivalence. Thus, transformations may therefore not only alter the appearance of the threat but also the apparent functionality of the capability. When we tried to run a control experiment, this limitation became concrete. When designing a semantically equivalent arm, too few name changes were considered semantically equivalent, so that arm was not run. That is one of the reasons that the experiments were not able to clearly identify threat vocabulary as the main driver of the sensitivity.
paragraphs.zh: 在使名称更明显地与威胁相关和保持表示的含义之间也存在权衡。 在我们的 ASB 实验的 A1 分支中，名称的变化并未经过独立验证以确认其语义等价性。 因此，这些转换可能不仅会改变威胁的外观，还会改变能力的表面功能。 当我们尝试运行一个对照实验时，这一局限性变得具体可见。 在设计一个语义等价的分支时，被认为具有语义等价性的名称变化太少，因此该分支并未运行。 这就是实验未能明确识别出威胁词汇是敏感性的主要驱动因素的原因之一。

sents.zh: 在使名称更明显地与威胁相关和保持表示的含义之间也存在权衡。

sents.zh: 这就是实验未能明确识别出威胁词汇是敏感性的主要驱动因素的原因之一。

paragraphs.en: Our experiment with MCPTox does provide a stronger sensitivity control in the S3 arm where we match the threat-neutral names to the threat-related names of the N1 arm on identifier properties. For GPT-5-mini, the S3 arm replicates most of N1’s ASR shift, showing that the threat vocabulary is not necessary for most of that effect. The S3 arm does not isolate every property of an identifier; moreover, the tokenizer used for token count on GPT-5-mini may not be exact under Haiku 4.5’s tokenizer. Thus the sensitivity attribution is not completely resolved.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 MCPTox 的实验确实在 S3 分支中提供了更强的敏感度控制，在该分支中，我们将威胁中立名称与 N1 分支中基于标识符属性的威胁相关名称进行了匹配。 对于 GPT-5-mini，S3 分支复现了 N1 的大部分 ASR 变化，这表明威胁词汇并非产生这种效应的必要条件。 S3 分支并未完全隔离标识符的每一项属性；此外，在 GPT-5-mini 上用于计算词元数量的分词器，在 Haiku 4.5 的分词器下可能并不精确。 因此，敏感度的归因问题尚未得到完全解决。

sents.en: Our experiment with MCPTox does provide a stronger sensitivity control in the S3 arm where we match the threat-neutral names to the threat-related names of the N1 arm on identifier properties.
sents.zh: 我们对 MCPTox 的实验确实在 S3 分支中提供了更强的敏感度控制，在该分支中，我们将威胁中立名称与 N1 分支中基于标识符属性的威胁相关名称进行了匹配。

paragraphs.en: For future work one can design tighter controls that can vary semantics, tokenization, and structure of the identifier to determine to which properties of the representation the sensitivity can be attributed.
paragraphs.zh: 在未来的工作中，可以设计更严格的控制方法，通过改变标识符的语义、分词和结构，来确定敏感性可归因于表示的哪些属性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated three benchmarks and three model configurations: GPT-5-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5 on ASB and MCPTox, and GPT-4o-mini on AgentDojo. The experiments show the sensitivity to threat representation in the tested settings but do not establish its scale or generalization beyond the tested scope. Moreover, our 28,904 runs are not necessarily independent as the transformations applied are shared across runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了三项基准测试和三种模型配置：在 ASB 和 MCPTox 上测试 GPT-5-mini 和 Claude Haiku 4.5，以及在 AgentDojo 上测试 GPT-4o-mini。 实验表明，在测试设置中，模型对威胁表示具有敏感性，但并未确定其影响程度或超出测试范围的泛化能力。 此外，我们的 28,904 次运行未必相互独立，因为所应用的转换操作在所有运行中是共享的。

sents.zh: 我们评估了三项基准测试和三种模型配置：在 ASB 和 MCPTox 上测试 GPT-5-mini 和 Claude Haiku 4.5，以及在 AgentDojo 上测试 GPT-4o-mini。

paragraphs.en: We plan to extend this work across a larger set of models, benchmarks, attacks and also evaluate defenses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们计划将这项工作扩展到更多模型、基准测试和攻击方法，并对防御机制进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Since the benchmark scores are often used for comparisons, one important direction for future work could be to establish if model rankings or defense rankings reverse under representation changes. Testing that question would require multiple models or defenses with sufficient headroom under the same transformation family.
paragraphs.zh: 由于基准分数常被用于比较，未来研究的一个重要方向可能是确定模型排名或防御排名在表示变化下是否会反转。 要验证这个问题，需要在同一变换族下测试多个具有足够余量的模型或防御方法。

paragraphs.en: Agent-security benchmarks are often interpreted as measuring how robust a model is to an attack. Our results show that this measurement can depend on how the benchmark presents that attack to the LLM agent. We introduced threat-preserving representation sensitivity (TPRS) as a measure of the effect of a change in the representation of the attack seen by the agent while the underlying task, harmful action, security policy, ground truth, and evaluation criteria stay the same.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体安全基准通常被解释为衡量模型对攻击的鲁棒性。 我们的研究结果表明，这种测量方式可能取决于该基准向大型语言模型智能体呈现攻击的方式。 我们提出了威胁保留表示敏感性（TPRS），作为衡量攻击表示方式变化对智能体影响的一种指标，而底层任务、有害行为、安全策略、真实情况以及评估标准均保持不变。

sents.en: Agent-security benchmarks are often interpreted as measuring how robust a model is to an attack.
sents.zh: 智能体安全基准通常被解释为衡量模型对攻击的鲁棒性。

sents.en: Our results show that this measurement can depend on how the benchmark presents that attack to the LLM agent.
sents.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，这种测量方式可能取决于该基准向大型语言模型智能体呈现攻击的方式。

sents.en: We introduced threat-preserving representation sensitivity (TPRS) as a measure of the effect of a change in the representation of the attack seen by the agent while the underlying task, harmful action, security policy, ground truth, and evaluation criteria stay the same.
sents.zh: 我们提出了威胁保留表示敏感性（TPRS），作为衡量攻击表示方式变化对智能体影响的一种指标，而底层任务、有害行为、安全策略、真实情况以及评估标准均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Across 28,904 agent runs on ASB, MCPTox, and AgentDojo, we found that TPRS can be large, can both increase and decrease security scores, and is not uniform across the different benchmarks. When we changed threat-related names to more neutral-sounding names, we saw an increase in committed ASR in ASB, whereas introducing threat-related names reduced ASR in MCPTox. The ASR effect observed in AgentDojo for a similar change in representation was much smaller, despite a benign utility change. On MCPTox, our controls showed that explicit threat vocabulary is not necessary for most of the GPT-5-mini effect.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ASB、MCPTox 和 AgentDojo 上进行的 28,904 次智能体运行中，我们发现 TPRS 的规模可能很大，既可能提高也可能降低安全分数，并且在不同基准测试中的表现并不一致。 当我们将威胁相关的名称改为听起来更中性的名称时，ASB 中的已提交 ASR 有所上升，而在 MCPTox 中引入威胁相关名称则降低了 ASR。 尽管 AgentDojo 中类似的表示变化并未涉及恶意效用改变，但观察到的 ASR 影响要小得多。 在 MCPTox 上，我们的控制实验表明，GPT-5-mini 效应的实现大多并不需要明确的威胁相关词汇。

sents.en: Across 28,904 agent runs on ASB, MCPTox, and AgentDojo, we found that TPRS can be large, can both increase and decrease security scores, and is not uniform across the different benchmarks.
sents.zh: 在 ASB、MCPTox 和 AgentDojo 上进行的 28,904 次智能体运行中，我们发现 TPRS 的规模可能很大，既可能提高也可能降低安全分数，并且在不同基准测试中的表现并不一致。

sents.en: When we changed threat-related names to more neutral-sounding names, we saw an increase in committed ASR in ASB, whereas introducing threat-related names reduced ASR in MCPTox.
sents.zh: 当我们将威胁相关的名称改为听起来更中性的名称时，ASB 中的已提交 ASR 有所上升，而在 MCPTox 中引入威胁相关名称则降低了 ASR。

sents.en: The ASR effect observed in AgentDojo for a similar change in representation was much smaller, despite a benign utility change.
sents.zh: 尽管 AgentDojo 中类似的表示变化并未涉及恶意效用改变，但观察到的 ASR 影响要小得多。

sents.en: On MCPTox, our controls showed that explicit threat vocabulary is not necessary for most of the GPT-5-mini effect.
sents.zh: 在 MCPTox 上，我们的控制实验表明，GPT-5-mini 效应的实现大多并不需要明确的威胁相关词汇。

paragraphs.en: We conclude that a benchmark measure of security may be dependent on representation decisions that are usually made implicitly. For any security claims intended to extend beyond one specific interface, benchmarks should evaluate the same under controlled threat-preserving variants rather than treating a single representation as measurement-neutral.
paragraphs.zh: 我们得出结论，安全性的基准衡量可能依赖于通常以隐式方式做出的表示决策。 对于任何旨在超越单一特定接口的安全性主张，基准测试应在受控的威胁保留变体下进行评估，而不是将某种单一表示视为测量中立的。

sents.zh: 我们得出结论，安全性的基准衡量可能依赖于通常以隐式方式做出的表示决策。
